projects.name: Project Manager
details: Consulting, India | 2014 – 2015
• Provided strategic project management consulting to drive short -term banking modernization initiatives, aligning
technology upgrades with business objectives, engineered rigorous test plans and execution strategies to independently
validate with functional requirements.
• Architected and implemented remediation frameworks to eliminate critical IT control gaps, substantially
strengthening the organization’s overall governance and risk posture.
• Redesigned privileged access & control framework resolving long-standing governance deficiencies.

projects.name: Project Manager
details: SBG, Jeddah – Saudi Arabia | 2010 – 2014
• Led end-to-end Oracle ERP implementations, orchestrating the decommissioning of legacy systems to streamline
global enterprise operations and data integrity.
• Pioneered an enterprise-wide change management framework, significantly enhancing audit readiness and
governance across complex regulatory environments.
• Directed IT audit methodology development, leveraging advanced tools to strengthen control effectiveness, risk
mitigation, and compliance reporting.
Application Analyst / Product Owner
Qatar First Investment Bank, Doha - Qatar | 2009 – 2009
• Implemented IAM for granular entitlement structures (e.g., Maker-Checker workflows, tiered payment authorization
limits) for corporate clients.
• Managed end-to-end SIT/UAT phases, validating that technical deployments met the business requirements.
• Led the implementation Asset Management Services, Operating Lease, Mortgage products for the new bank.
• Product Owner for Asset Management and Mortgage products supporting an Investment Banking platform.
• Managed product backlog, business requirements, SIT/UAT, and production readiness.
• Designed authorization workflows including Maker-Checker, entitlement hierarchy, and approval matrices for institutional clients.
• Partnered with business users to automate investment banking operational workflows.
• Delivered secure onboarding capabilities for high-value institutional customers.
Application Analyst
SAMBA Financial Group, Riyadh – Saudi Arabia | 2007 – 2008
• Orchestrated the technical carve-out of a banking entity, delivering a standalone General Ledger (GL) and complex
data migration for a Capital & Investment Management entity.
• Played a pivotal role in implementing of multi-currency mutual fund products, equities, corporate actions,
ensuring regulatory requirements are met with seamless transaction processing
• Partnered with Compliance and Legal stakeholders to integrate real-time, automated AML/KYC screening vendors
collaborated with Corporate Operations, and Risk to align the onboarding product roadmap with high-value institutional
pipeline priorities.
• Implemented Investment Management solutions supporting Equity products and Mutual Fund operations.
• Worked on Corporate Actions processing supporting dividend, bonus, rights issue, and stock split events.
• Participated in business analysis for Equity transaction processing and investment product servicing.
• Supported investment product onboarding and lifecycle management for institutional customers.
• Coordinated with Compliance and Operations teams to ensure AML/KYC adherence for investment products.
IT Analyst / Programmer
Saudi Hollandi Bank, Riyadh – Saudi Arabia | 2002 – 2007
• Integrated complex payment gateways and credit bureau systems , optimizing real-time transaction accuracy and
speed across multiple digital channels.
• Engineered the Bank Master Application (Kindle/Misys) using C and Pro*C, architecting flexible interfaces to meet
evolving regulatory requirements, eliminating operational bottlenecks and ensuring end-to-end data integrity across the
enterprise.
